description: This Java source file defines the class WebToolsDbEvents, which provides methods related to database entity model induction from a data source within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functionality to create an XML representation of the data model based on database introspection, along with configuration and error handling.

classes.name: WebToolsDbEvents
classes.description: Provides static methods for inducing data models from a database and generating XML representations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: modelInduceFromDb
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to induce a data model from a database, generating an XML document that represents the model, and returning a string status indicating success or error.
